ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: pairwise_logsigmoid_advantage_gap_weighted_avg_clip_norm
ir.intuition: Inject explicit clipping normalization on the advantage_gap and weight signals before combination and aggregation to ensure numerical stability and bounded influence from extreme values, improving training robustness.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_clip = clamp(advantage_gap, adv_min, adv_max)
weight_clip = clamp(weight, weight_min, weight_max)
x = clamp(alpha * scale * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) + beta * adv_clip, -20, 20)
loss = -logsigmoid(x)
weighted_loss = loss * weight_clip
final_loss = sum(weighted_loss) / sum(weight_clip) + gamma * mean(softplus(entropy_gap))
return final_loss
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    advantage_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    entropy_gap = batch.get('entropy_gap', ops.zeros_like(lpw))

    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 1.0)))
    gamma = float(extra.get('gamma', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('gamma', 0.1)))
    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 2.0))

    adv_min = float(extra.get('adv_min', -5.0))
    adv_max = float(extra.get('adv_max', 5.0))
    weight_min = float(extra.get('weight_min', 1e-3))
    weight_max = float(extra.get('weight_max', 10.0))

    adv_clip = ops.clamp(advantage_gap, adv_min, adv_max)
    weight_clip = ops.clamp(weight, weight_min, weight_max)

    x = ops.add(ops.mul(alpha * scale, ops.sub(lpw, lpl)), ops.mul(beta, adv_clip))
    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)

    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))

    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss, weight_clip)
    sum_weighted_loss = ops.sum(weighted_loss)
    sum_weight_clip = ops.sum(weight_clip)
    safe_sum_weight = ops.maximum(sum_weight_clip, ops.ones_like(sum_weight_clip))
    weighted_avg_loss = ops.div(sum_weighted_loss, safe_sum_weight)

    entropy_reg = ops.mul(gamma, ops.mean(ops.softplus(entropy_gap)))

    final_loss = ops.add(weighted_avg_loss, entropy_reg)
    return final_loss
